description:
Outcome: The volunteer can operate, recover and correct the first version, derived from brief workflow correctness and privacy constraints.
Scope: Deploy/migrate/coordinator provisioning, backup/restore, safe logs, email/scheduler monitoring, verified 40-plot registry and paper prior holdings. Contact-retention policy before live data. Audited, validated administrative corrections for mistaken allocation/household or vacancy preserving uniqueness and queue order.
Excludes: General self-service administration features; post-v1 plot map and map-dependent launch checks.
Acceptance: Staging deploy and restore demonstrated with synthetic data; digest failure recovery rehearsed. Correction transactions preserve one plot per household/one household per plot, FCFS and audit. Owner-supplied timezone/dates/accounts and contact-retention policy recorded before live use.
Behaviour: Safe failure, rollback and recovery runbook; no contact or token leakage in logs.
Verification: Staging rehearsal, backup restore and transactional correction tests; scheduler/mail monitoring and documented recovery checks.
Prerequisites: T-008, T-009, T-011, T-013, T-014.
Assumptions: Owner supplies provider accounts, exact season dates and garden timezone; synthetic data used until ready.
title: Establish deployment, recovery and correction procedures
